newsitem.title: USA: TCI to take charge in current quarter.
newsitem.headline: TCI to take charge in current quarter.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc will take a one-time charge in the current quarter for the 2,500 layoffs it announced on Thursday, a company spokesman said.
Bob Thomson declined to disclose the scope of the charge and would only say that TCI has a severance program that is competitive in the industry.
TCI workers, who were told on Wednesday that they would no longer have jobs, vacate their offices on Friday, Thomson said.
Thomson also said TCI is in talks with its programmers to find ways that are "win-win" situations for both parties.
TCI needs to cut its costs in order to boost its financial picture.
He said the talks with the programmers are "elaborate and complex" and said press reports indicating that TCI gets paid by the programmers for carriage are an "oversimplification."

He said some of the ways to amend current programming contracts include offering an improved spot on the dial or reserving space for a programmer for new channels in the future. TCI will also sell the four aircraft in its corporate fleet. Thomson said the planes were needed because TCI executives need to fly to many out of the way locations.
